product.name: Monoprice Alpha In-Ceiling Speakers 6.5in Carbon Fiber 2-Way with 15-degree Angled Drivers (pair)
product.description: This carbon fiber in‑ceiling speaker is the perfect combination of performance and style. The use of carbon fiber for the woofer means that the speaker can hit harder, go lower, and handle more power with significantly less distortion than conventional drivers. The silk dome tweeter produces clean, crisp, and clear highs and mids. You can fine tune the blend of sound using the built‑in high frequency attenuator in case the sound is too bright. The metal grille can be painted to match your ceiling and attaches easily using magnets.                                            Louder with Less Power | Higher Power Handling with Less DistortionControl High Frequencies | Easy to Install | Use up to 10AWG Cable                          6.5‑inch Carbon Fiber 2‑way In‑Ceiling Speaker with 15° Angled Driver                                                                                                                                                            Sound Quality                          Style                          Simplicity                                              Sound Quality: Life is too short for speakers that don't sound great! We believe that the whole point of listening to music is to hear it as the artist intended. Our engineers and audio experts have spent countless hours listening to and comparing various speakers until we were satisfied we had found models that fit our demanding standards.                    Style: While Monoprice™ believes in function over form, there is nothing wrong with having speakers that look good, too. This in‑ceiling speaker helps reduce clutter by getting your speakers off the floor or bookshelves. The magnetic metal grille can be painted to match your ceiling, so it virtually disappears from view.                    Simplicity: Installation is as easy as it can get. Use the included cutout template to mark your ceiling, make the cut then, using only a screwdriver, secure the speaker to the ceiling with the easy install mounting tabs.                                      Carbon fiber gives you higher sensitivity, deeper bass, and higher power handling.                                            Carbon fiber woofers are lighter and stiffer than conventional materials used in speaker manufacturing. The speaker cone is more sensitive to power, which means that you get more volume using less power. Additionally, the stiffer material means deeper bass and higher power handling, with significantly less distortion.                                                                              120 watts maximum input power            6.5" carbon fiber woofer with rubber surround            1" silk dome tweeter                                                58Hz ~ 20kHz frequency response            Built‑in high frequency attenuator            Paintable magnetic grille                                                                                                Stud finder            Carpenter's level            Marking pen or pencil            Drywall cutter                                                14AWG CL2 in‑wall rated speaker wire (P/N 2821)            Wire strippers            Phillips screwdriver                                          .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}                                                                                                              1 Year Replacement Warranty                                      Monoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
